Name: Sweetpea Preview Studio - In Game Image Exporter
Author: CosmicSweetpea
Description:
[b]SWEETPEA PREVIEW STUDIO[/b]

This is a tool I developed for personal use and have been using but decided it certainly would be of use to somebody else here. Sweetpea Preview Studio is for anyone who has ever finished a large furniture collection, stared at all of the items, and realized with horror now they have to make the preview images, this is supposed to be an easy in game export tool.

This is open to me updating for the future, for right now I am a proponent of keep it simple stupid.

The MoonChime lamps I have not released yet, that is what I was using for the preview images if anyone was wondering.
[heading]What It Does[/heading]
[list]
[*]Sweetpea Preview Studio finds compatible custom furniture collections already installed in your Mods folder and displays them inside a dedicated preview studio.[/*]
[*]Choose a collection, select the kind of preview you need, and the studio will create the images for you.[/*]
[*]You do not need to move furniture files into the studio or prepare a separate sprite sheet.[/*]
[/list][heading]Export Options[/heading]
[b]Main Preview[/b]
Creates a clean preview of the currently displayed page.

[b]Tightly Packed[/b]
Removes unnecessary empty space around the sprites and places the items closer together.

[b]All Rotations[/b]
Shows every supported direction for each furniture item together.

[b]Collage[/b]
Creates a more decorative, staggered collection preview instead of a strict grid.

[b]Full Collection[/b]
Exports the entire furniture collection across large organized sheets.

[b]By Category[/b]
Separates the collection into groups such as chairs, tables, lamps, rugs, and other furniture types.

[b]Separate Transparent PNGs[/b]
Exports every item and supported rotation as its own cropped image with a transparent background.

[b]Export Item List[/b]
Creates a text file containing the furniture names, item IDs, categories, and available rotations.

[b]Title Card Maker[/b]
Creates a matching title graphic for your preview images.
[list]
[*]Edit the title and subtitle [/*]
[*]Choose the canvas, card, and text colors [/*]
[*]Use built in color swatches [/*]
[*]Fine tune colors with RGB controls [/*]
[*]Export a complete title card [/*]
[*]Export the title and subtitle on a transparent background [/*]
[/list][b]Export Everything[/b]
Creates every available preview format, the item list, and the title card files in one batch.



[b][size=4]The Backstory[/size][/b]

I make a lot of Stardew Valley furniture and decorative content and eventually, creating the preview images became almost as much work as creating the mods themselves, especially when using multiple programs to create the previews, resize the images in Aseprite or Illustrator, cut out every individual item, place everything into Photoshop, add labels, and organize the collection into a usable preview. 

Every new collection meant loading the game, finding every item, placing everything one piece at a time, rotating it, rearranging the room, trying to get a clean screenshot, realizing something was missing, doing it again, and then cutting out and organizing all of the images afterward. It was tedious, time consuming, and simply put it was irritating me in a way I wasn't anticipating when I started uploading my mods lol.

So I made Sweetpea Preview Studio. What began as a way to stop personally suffering through furniture previews and resizing of sprites then turned into a full creator workflow for displaying, organizing, and exporting an entire collection in a consistent format. It is especially useful for large furniture packs where manually dealing with every item would take approximately one thousand years.
